name: Alias Assignment Policy
description: Weights, vetoes and thresholds for resolving a short/ambiguous surface (flight-log initials 'AA', partial names) to a canonical entity, through the ONE collapse equation. Governed, content-hashed data, not code. Tuned so initials NEVER collapse on their own — corroboration (co-occurrence, exact/id) is required — and the unresolved PARK (→ LDU-P).
